new_scholarship.description: The Bicocca International Scholarship Programme (BISP) is a merit award from the University of Milano-Bicocca for international students who hold a foreign qualification, are not resident in Italy and are admitted to one of the University's English-taught degree programmes. Around 100 scholarships are awarded each year, with five dedicated to each eligible English-taught course, mainly at Master's level. Each scholarship is worth EUR 10,000 gross per academic year plus exemption from tuition fees, and is renewable for a maximum of three years on Bachelor's and single-cycle degree programmes and two years on Master's degree programmes. No separate application is needed: applying to an eligible programme makes the candidate automatically part of the selection, and applicants are not required to submit any further form.

new_scholarship.description: The ISU Bocconi Scholarship is Bocconi University's implementation of the Italian Right to University Education Scholarship for students entering the first year of a Bachelor of Science, Integrated Master of Arts in Law or Master of Science programme in academic year 2027-2028. It combines a cash stipend with services and supplements, including a free daily meal valued at EUR 829.00 for a.y. 2026-27, access to preferential-rate canteen services and a 200-hour work-study programme. Eligibility depends on three separate tests: enrolment for the absolute first year, an economic test set annually by the Lombardy Region (ISEE/ISEEU Parificato not above EUR 26,887.93 and ISPE/ISPEEU Parificato not above EUR 58,452.06 for a.y. 2026-27), and a merit test verified after the fact through credit thresholds. International candidates apply under this call, while Bocconi and Italian applicants are directed to the separate Bocconi4Access to Education call.

Each scholarship provides a cash benefit of EUR 7,000 gross per academic year plus exemption from all amounts due for university enrolment, except the first instalment of the student contribution.
